entries.en: A nagami kumquat grew in a large pot beside the terrace.
entries.zh: 一棵椭圆金柑生长在露台旁的大花盆里。

entries.en: The zoology display included a model of a naked mole rat.
entries.zh: 动物学展览中有一个裸滨鼠模型。

entries.en: The botanist placed these specimens under the nasturtium family.
entries.zh: 植物学家将这些标本归入旱金莲科。
